Real 2-D vent cross-section (FiPy)
Campaign 0Mechanismreproduction
How to read: A resolved 2-D cross-section through one pore / chimney-wall slice — a real FiPy finite-volume solve, every pixel a solved cell (NOT a schematic, and NOT a 3-D reconstruction). Spatial temperature, pH, reducing power (H₂ + alkalinity) and porosity share a consistent pore cross-section; axes are in cm (scale bars), inlet = cold acidic OCEAN (left), outlet = hot alkaline CONDUIT (right), with the mineral wall / precipitation front the dotted porosity contour. White streamlines (constant ψ) trace the real Darcy–Boussinesq convection (flow arrows: hot conduit rises, cold ocean sinks). Settled: 50 °C, pH 9.41 (inside the Lost City window). The across-wall gradient is the mechanistic anchor of the vent.
